title: 貴方のこぶしが名残に揺れて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm on my way back from an outing with Meisho Doto until we spot Haru Urara by the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: La-la-laa! La-di-daa! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, Doto! On your way home?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, I am, but… Urara, is that… shadowboxing you're doing?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: No! I'm practicing my singing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: My singing instructor said the song should pack more of a punch, so I'm working on that!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: A different punch? You mean there's more than one type?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Well, um… I think your instructor was asking for… more punch in your voice rather… than your fists.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow, so you can tell what kind of punch it is, Doto! Show me how to do it, pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh! You want m-me to?! I don't think my voice will serve as a good example!
choice_data_list: Singing just one line wouldn't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I'm not so confident with my singing, though… Well, if you're okay with enka, then…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'd be happy to sing something for you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Where toooo? You say you will never… retuuurn! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow, that was amazing! Just like the singers in kimono on TV!
choice_data_list: Even a heartfelt ballad can pack a punch.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So that's what you mean by "punch." I'm starting to understand!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: All righty, I've almost got this! Doto, sing with me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Where toooo? You say you will never… retuuurn! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: WHERE TOOOO? YOU SAY YOU'LL NEVER RETURN! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hm? Why does mine feel a little different?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-well, you certainly are projecting enough… but I th-think you're missing a little vibrato… maybe… Umm…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh… vibrato? Vibrato, vibrato… Like, bravo?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No, um, don't overthink it… It's m-more like… open yourself up and sing more freely!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Your voice has a lot of power to it, Urara… and it's f-full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Also, you're very honest… and hardworking, so I know you'll get the hang of it with a few more tries!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Woooow! Are you complimenting me?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eep! I'm s-sorry! It's not like my opinion matters! I'm so sorry if I came off uppity!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hee hee… Yippee! I'm gonna nail this vibrato punch thing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto continues singing together with Haru Urara, giving her advice along the way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eventually, Haru Urara notices a change in her voice!

text_block_list.name: Doto and Urara
text_block_list.text: Where toooo? You say you will never… retuuurn! ♪
choice_data_list: Whoa… that's what I call punch!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! I did it! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to you, Doto! You helped me practice and praised me a lot!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I d-didn't do anything but sing a song!
choice_data_list: You should be proud. It's okay to hold your head high.
You should be proud. It's okay to hold your head high.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I d-didn't do anything but sing a song!
choice_data_list: You should be proud. It's okay to hold your head high.
You should be proud. It's okay to hold your head high.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Th-this is so embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But… it f-f-felt really good to sing… It might be kind of fun… maybe.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Singing is a whole lot of fun! Let's sing all the way home, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, o-okay! If you don't mind my voice, then sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the haze of approaching dusk, two voices echo by the riverbank—strong and unyielding, yet a little forlorn.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waagh?! I shouldn't be s-so shameless!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really? But there's so much to like about you, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You're kind and you're good at singing! And that's not everything!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?! Well, that goes for you as well, Urara!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You're always so cheerful, and you bothered to befriend someone like me. You're… very, very likable!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two exchange compliments the whole way back to the dorm, with Meisho Doto's face turning a very bright red.
